st.t: Talk to Councillor Halgrive outside the East Ardougne church.
Talk to Doctor Orbon in the East Ardougne Church.
Wear the plague jacket and trousers and go to the fenced enclosure north-west of East Ardougne's north bank. Go in by the gate on its west side.
Wield the cattleprod and leave by the west gate.
Find the blue sheep north-west of the enclosure. Keep tapping a sheep to prod it: it moves the way you're facing, and wanders back if you wait too long.
Drive it to the west gate. It goes in by itself; if it stops just outside, prod it once more.
Prod one of the yellow sheep north of the enclosure to the enclosure gate.
Prod one of the green sheep east of the enclosure to the enclosure gate.
Prod one of the red sheep south east of the enclosure to the enclosure gate.
Use the sheep feed on each of the four sheep in the enclosure until they are all dead.
Use all four sets of bones on the incinerator in the enclosure.
